held.iphone-17-vs-iphone-air: Air described as $799 mid-range with A18/dual camera; it is the thin $999 A19 Pro model. IP69/100m water rating invented.
held.camry-vs-corolla: "3.5L V6 203 hp" Camry does not exist; current Camry is hybrid-only 2.5L (~225 hp). Corolla 139 hp is also outdated (169 hp).
held.c-17-globemaster-vs-c5-galaxy: C-5 payload 921,000 lb is wrong (~281,000 lb; 840,000 is MTOW). C-17 CAN carry an M1 Abrams. Cargo volumes inverted (C-5 hold is larger).
held.amazon-music-vs-spotify: Table says Spotify has lossless and Amazon has none; FAQ says the opposite. 627M is Spotify MAU not subscribers. "Music Unlimited ad-supported free with Prime" mislabels the Prime Music tier.
held.toyota-tacoma-vs-tundra: City fuel economy 10 mpg / 8 mpg is wrong (Tacoma ~20-21 city). Payload figures low.
held.chatgpt-vs-perplexity: Stale: ChatGPT free tier has web search; "knowledge cutoff April 2024"; Perplexity "1-2M users" and "Claude 3.5 Sonnet base model" are outdated.
held.deezer-vs-spotify: Spotify launched lossless in 2025 — page says none at any price. Deezer "8M users" understated. Free-tier bitrate rows dubious.
held.mini-led-vs-oled: OLED lifespan "8,000-10,000 hours" is false (30k-100k). Panel manufacturing costs invented.
held.air-force-reserve-vs-air-national-guard: "108 fighter squadrons" wrong (ANG ~25). "14-18 days per month on duty" absurd for Guard (1 weekend/month + 15 days/yr). Deployment-rate percentages invented.
held.army-reserve-vs-national-guard: "2+ year combat rotations" for Army Reserve is wrong (9-12 months). Overseas-combat-as-primary-mission framing is off.
held.marines-vs-navy: "~1,800 Marines per carrier" (MEUs ride amphibious ships, not carriers). Navy boot camp is 10 weeks, not 8. Deployment-speed row is not a real metric.
held.lucid-vs-tesla: Tesla market cap "$340B" (≈$1T+), "4 factories" (6), Lucid 2024 deliveries 10,241 not 9,180; "200 Lucid charging locations" invented.
held.cx-30-vs-mazda-cx-3: CX-3 discontinued in the US after 2021; "$24,950 2026 MSRP" and "2026 standard safety" rows are fiction.
held.accord-vs-honda-civic: 252 hp 2.0T Accord was discontinued for 2023; current Accord is 1.5T 192 hp / hybrid 204 hp. Civic 180 hp is the Si only.
held.kia-vs-toyota: "18.9M Kia vehicles sold in 2024" (actual ~3.1M; Toyota ~10.8M, not 33.4M). Dealer counts and EV-model counts dubious.
held.model-3-vs-model-s: Model S "$45,000" starting price (≈$95k), "optional third row" (discontinued 2021), "$108 per mile of range" is a meaningless metric.
